fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Reduced-length CD weaving section carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year weave volume is a scheme-specific, mechanism-backed sideswipe/rear-end exposure concern squarely relevant at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim rests on recorded GA-drawing geometry and recorded 1,100 pcu/h input fact, but the only verbatim quote (EV-IN-001) is generic PIARC early-fault-detection rationale, not support for the weave-volume/length claim, capping at 1.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as safety_concern with null normative basis, framed as a conflict-exposure check rather than a compliance assertion, consistent with the qualified /int:preliminary-design PIARC baseline.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable dual option—80 m weave-length extension or entry ramp metering—both viable while geometry remains changeable at preliminary design; not a null recommendation.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU relevance explicitly addressed and correctly resolved as not applicable via grade-separated shared-use paths, matching the acknowledge-and-scope-out case.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled shared-use-path crossings at free-flow ramp terminals conflicting with a stated corridor continuity objective is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue for an interchange scheme.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal layout/objective claims rest on narratively asserted 'recorded' facts without evidence_id citations, and EV-IN-001 is only a generic design-quality quote used as context, so the required verbatim support for the uncontrolled-crossing mechanism is absent.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a categorical safety_concern under the explicitly qualified PIARC-derived baseline with null normative basis, keeping safety and compliance semantics distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable—names the northern loop-ramp path crossing and prescribes signalised or grade-separated treatment at both retained terminals—viable at preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists on the shared-use paths are the explicit focus, with their exposure at each ramp-terminal crossing directly addressed.
